scope: Sign only: visible face, rim, suspension, ornamental bracket, screen placement, color and sharpness. No overall-scene score.

inspection.supplemental_crop_enlargement: PIL, 3x nearest-neighbor; both images inspected because the requested crop clips the reference bracket's wall attachment
inspection.execution: Single-agent review; no subagents launched; model not changed; no independent-reviewer consensus ranking or external calls
inspection.scoring: Subjective visible similarity, 0-10; 10 means visually indistinguishable in these images, not merely the correct subject or source texture
inspection.geometry_measurements: Screen-space estimates from inspected images, approximately +/-3 pixels; not segmented or fitted measurements
inspection.provenance_policy: The user-authorized source crop and real 3D rim/bracket are user-supplied implementation context, not proof of visual acceptance.

verdict: The face is recognizably close in artwork and screen size, but visibly softer, browner and more heavily shaded than the reference. The ornamental support remains substantially different. The sign as a whole is not picture-perfect.

exact_matches.observation: Both display a large black 9 with a smaller stacked 3 over 4 and a horizontal fraction rule to its right.
exact_matches.qualification: Exact content/layout identity, not pixel-identical glyph edges, dimensions or rendering.

close_matches_not_exact: The face follows the same serif numeral design and recognizable stain, scratch and fastener-mark arrangement.
Both have a weathered tan circular face enclosed by a dark metal rim.
The disk occupies almost the same upper-right screen location and approximately the same 145-150 pixel diameter.
Both supports include a horizontal upper member, a descending diagonal member and a brass-toned ring near the hanging end; their detailed silhouettes do not match.

differences.evidence: Within the requested crop, the actual face is warmer orange-brown and darker than the reference's lighter, more neutral parchment tone. Its perimeter, especially the lower face, has a stronger dark shading band.
differences.required_change: Match the rendered face's luminance and warm/cool balance to the reference and reduce the excessive peripheral darkening without erasing the source weathering.

differences.evidence: At 4x, the actual 9 outline, fraction numerals/rule and mottled surface marks are visibly softer and less distinct. The reference's fine face texture and edge contrast survive enlargement better.
differences.required_change: Recover the reference's screen-space texture detail and numeral edge definition. Inspect the actual sampling/render path rather than assuming reuse of the source crop guarantees fidelity; the images alone do not establish the technical cause.

differences.evidence: The actual rim has a heavier, softer dark border and a conspicuous pale/gold lower-left outer bevel. The reference has a finer, crisper layered dark rim and more legible small perimeter fittings, including its lower tab.
differences.required_change: Refine the projected rim profile, bevel highlight, lower shadow band and small fittings to match the reference silhouette and material response.

differences.evidence: The actual upper assembly reads as a simple upright, left-side brass ring and block-like gold cap. The reference has a more articulated hanging connection, slender decorative vertical fittings and a rounded ornamental finial. Their silhouettes and highlight placement differ.
differences.required_change: Reproduce the visible finial, ring position, vertical hanger and connection to the disk rather than retaining generic cap-and-rod shapes.

differences.evidence: The actual is dominated by a plain, short triangular frame with a sparse loop. The reference has a small upper spiral, a large nested scroll assembly, a lower spiral and a substantial decorated wall plate. The reference reaches approximately x1265 and descends to y205; the actual principal support ends around x1215 and y125. Much of the missing reference ornament lies beyond x1220.
differences.required_change: Rebuild the bracket to the reference's full projected span and depth, including nested curls, lower scroll, end ornaments and wall attachment. This is a silhouette/geometry mismatch, not a face-texture problem.

differences.evidence: Approximate disk centers are actual (1081, 161) and reference (1085, 158). The actual disk is a few pixels left and down and reads slightly narrower/taller. Disk scale is close, but the whole assembly's footprint is not, because the bracket is markedly shorter.
differences.required_change: After correcting the support and rim, nudge the disk approximately 4 pixels right and 3 pixels up and refine its projected width/height against the reference. Do not move or scale the entire assembly as a substitute for rebuilding the bracket.

main_remaining_changes: Restore the reference bracket's scrollwork, full rightward reach, lower ornament and wall plate.
Match the suspension fittings and rim silhouette/highlights.
Make the face less brown/dark and recover the reference's crisp numeral edges and fine weathering.
Finish with the small right/up disk-placement and projected-shape corrections.
acceptance_reason: Matching source artwork and nearly matching disk placement are insufficient: visible face color/sharpness differences remain, and the suspension and ornamental bracket are clearly not close enough.
